repos_data.description: MCP server for Android — drive emulators and real devices over adb from Claude Code, Cursor, or VS Code. 73 tools: screenshots, UI hierarchy...
Run Android apps on your Mac like Mac apps: each in its own window with its own Dock icon, on Apple silicon. Notifications, game controllers...
MCP server that lets AI assistants (Claude, OpenCode, VS Code) control Android devices securely via ADB

repo_meta_data.description: Free ADB GUI and Android Emulator control panel for macOS. One click for dark mode, font scale, RTL and pseudo-locales, TalkBack, layout bounds, network speed and GPS: no adb commands. Layout Inspector in dp for any app (Compose and Views) with Figma overlay and TalkBack-order audit. Plus an MCP server for AI agents.
